name: JoAi: Delete Campaign

description.en: Permanently delete a campaign that is not currently sending. Use with care — this cannot be undone.
description.de: Eine Kampagne, die gerade nicht versendet, dauerhaft löschen. Vorsicht — dies kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden.
description.fr: Supprimer définitivement une campagne qui n'est pas en cours d'envoi. À utiliser avec précaution — irréversible.
description.es: Elimina permanentemente una campaña que no esté en envío. Úsalo con cuidado: no se puede deshacer.
description.it: Elimina definitivamente una campagna che non è in invio. Da usare con cautela — non reversibile.
description.ro: Șterge definitiv o campanie care nu este în curs de trimitere. Folosește cu atenție — nu poate fi anulată.

bot: Use when the user wants to remove a campaign. If the user refers to a campaign by name, list campaigns first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Campaign ID

description.en: The hashid of the campaign to delete
description.de: Die Hashid der zu löschenden Kampagne
description.fr: Le hashid de la campagne à supprimer
description.es: El hashid de la campaña a eliminar

inputs.bot: The campaign hash ID. If the user refers to a campaign by name, list campaigns first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug of the campaign. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug der Kampagne. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe de la campagne. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo de la campaña. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team della campagna. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei campaniei. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team the campaign belongs to. Omit to use the current team.
